Can you confirm: a) whether Redwood can map incoming Ariba attribute names to the order form fields without additional custom middleware, and b) whether you have a recommended redline for the order-form-to-MSA precedence point?

We prefer a short working call (30m) next week and will bring our Ariba admin and legal counsel.

Internal —

Quick legal positions to include in the redline (high-level):

1) Precedence: Add this two-line clause to the Order Form preamble: "Except as expressly set forth in an Order Form (pricing, quantities, delivery instructions), the MSA governs and supersedes any conflicting terms contained in Order Forms, Portals, or procurement system exports. No metadata field in a procurement portal shall be interpreted to amend material MSA obligations (including indemnity, liability cap, data processing obligations) unless explicitly signed as an MSA amendment."

2) Signatory matrix: We will accept an Order Form signature that references a signer_role attribute provided by the customer's portal, provided the signatory name and email are captured in the executed Order Form artifact and the signature method meets Redwood's e-sign standard. We should not permit a field like "signer_role" alone to alter liability thresholds — that must be in the signed document.

3) Auditability: For customers onboarding through EDI/Ariba, require retention of EDI acknowledgements (ASNs/850/855) for 2 years and a record of the signatory delegation. We will include a minimal evidence checklist in the onboarding packet.

I can prepare the exact redline language for insertion into redline_orderform_olga_v1.docx. Also added a DocuSign signatory matrix link for the Medix template: https://docusign.com/SignatoryMatrix/MP-7893 (internal reference).

Kimberly Park
